story.subtitle: OUR HERITAGE & VISION
story.title: Born in the Royal Corridors of Rajasthan, Engineered for the World
story.p1: Celebs Alley was founded with a singular conviction: that modern cosmetic science should not discard centuries of royal botanical wisdom, nor should traditional care operate without modern scientific precision.
story.p2: From our flagship center in Kota, Rajasthan, we pioneered a unified architecture that unites multi-spectral artificial intelligence with clinical dermatology and authentic Ayurvedic alchemy.
story.p3: Today, Celebs Alley powers consultations and bespoke treatment plans for over 48,000 discerning patrons across 24 Indian cities.

mission.title: Our Sacred Mission
mission.description: To democratize clinical-grade dermatological intelligence and deliver hyper-personalized luxury wellness regimens that restore cellular vitality from within.

vision.title: Our Global Vision
vision.description: To become the global gold standard in AI-driven aesthetic wellness, harmonizing ancient heritage with cutting-edge computer vision.

values.title: Absolute Purity

values.title: Evidence-Based AI

values.title: Patient-Centric Care

values.title: Privacy & Trust
values.description: Your biometric face-scan data is encrypted end-to-end and never sold to third-party advertisers.
